args:
echo "Waiting for services to be ready..."
timeout=600
interval=1
start_time=$(date +%s)

# Single check function
check_service_once() {
  name=$1
  port=$2
  path=$3
  
  if [ -n "$path" ]; then
    # HTTP health check
    http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 "http://$name:$port$path" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$http_code" -ge 200 ] && [ "$http_code" -lt 500 ]; then
      return 0
    fi
  else
    # TCP port check
    if nc -z $name $port 2>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  return 1
}

# Wait for specific service
wait_for_service() {
  name=$1
  port=$2
  path=$3
  
  echo "Waiting for $name:$port$path"
  
  while true; do
    current_time=$(date +%s)
    elapsed=$((current_time - start_time))
    if [ $elapsed -gt $timeout ]; then
      echo "Timeout waiting for $name"
      exit 1
    fi
    
    if check_service_once "$name" "$port" "$path"; then
      echo "$name is ready"
      return 0
    fi
    
    echo "$name not ready, waiting $interval seconds..."
    sleep $interval
  done
}

# Create temporary files for service lists
ready_services="/tmp/ready_services"
pending_services="/tmp/pending_services"
all_services="/tmp/all_services"

# Clear temp files
> "$ready_services"
> "$pending_services"
> "$all_services"

# Create list of all services
echo "ts-auth-service:8080:/api/v1/auth" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-user-service:8080:/api/v1/userservice/users" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-order-service:8080:/api/v1/orderservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-travel-service:8080:/api/v1/travelservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-travel2-service:8080:/api/v1/travel2service" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-preserve-service:8080:/api/v1/preserveservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-basic-service:8080:/api/v1/basicservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-station-service:8080:/api/v1/stationservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-train-service:8080:/api/v1/trainservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-route-service:8080:/api/v1/routeservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-price-service:8080:/api/v1/priceservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-seat-service:8080:/api/v1/seatservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-security-service:8080:/api/v1/securityservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-payment-service:8080:/api/v1/paymentservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-admin-basic-info-service:8080:/api/v1/adminbasicservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-admin-order-service:8080:/api/v1/adminorderservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-admin-route-service:8080:/api/v1/adminrouteservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-admin-travel-service:8080:/api/v1/admintravelservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-admin-user-service:8080:/api/v1/adminuserservice/users" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-assurance-service:8080:/api/v1/assuranceservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-avatar-service:8080:/api/v1/avatar" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-cancel-service:8080:/api/v1/cancelservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-config-service:8080:/api/v1/configservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-consign-price-service:8080:/api/v1/consignpriceservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-consign-service:8080:/api/v1/consignservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-contacts-service:8080:/api/v1/contactservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-execute-service:8080:/api/v1/executeservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-food-service:8080:/api/v1/foodservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-inside-payment-service:8080:/api/v1/inside_pay_service" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-notification-service:8080:/api/v1/notifyservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-order-other-service:8080:/api/v1/orderOtherService" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-preserve-other-service:8080:/api/v1/preserveotherservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-rebook-service:8080:/api/v1/rebookservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-route-plan-service:8080:/api/v1/routeplanservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-station-food-service:8080:/api/v1/stationfoodservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-train-food-service:8080:/api/v1/trainfoodservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-travel-plan-service:8080:/api/v1/travelplanservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-verification-code-service:8080:/api/v1/verifycode" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-wait-order-service:8080:/api/v1/waitorderservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "ts-food-delivery-service:8080:/api/v1/fooddeliveryservice" >> "$all_services"
echo "mysql:3306:" >> "$all_services"
echo "rabbitmq:5672:" >> "$all_services"

# First round: parallel check all services
echo "Performing initial parallel check of all services..."

while IFS= read -r service; do
  if [ -n "$service" ]; then
    name=$(echo "$service" | cut -d':' -f1)
    port=$(echo "$service" | cut -d':' -f2)
    path=$(echo "$service" | cut -d':' -f3)
    
    if check_service_once "$name" "$port" "$path"; then
      echo "$name is ready"
      echo "$service" >> "$ready_services"
    else
      echo "$name is not ready"
      echo "$service" >> "$pending_services"
    fi
  fi
done < "$all_services"

# Count services
ready_count=$(wc -l < "$ready_services" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
pending_count=$(wc -l < "$pending_services" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

# If all services are ready, exit
if [ "$pending_count" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "All services are ready!"
  exit 0
fi

echo "Ready services: $ready_count"
echo "Pending services: $pending_count"

# Second round: wait for pending services
while IFS= read -r service; do
  if [ -n "$service" ]; then
    name=$(echo "$service" | cut -d':' -f1)
    port=$(echo "$service" | cut -d':' -f2)
    path=$(echo "$service" | cut -d':' -f3)
    wait_for_service "$name" "$port" "$path"
  fi
done < "$pending_services"

# Clean up temp files
rm -f "$ready_services" "$pending_services" "$all_services"

echo "All services are ready!"
init_containers.name: wait-for-services

command:
if [[ -f /opt/bitnami/scripts/rabbitmq/nodeshutdown.sh ]]; then
    /opt/bitnami/scripts/rabbitmq/nodeshutdown.sh -t "120" -d "false"
else
    rabbitmqctl stop_app
fi
